VBO:0201193.summary: Playful and affectionate in his owner’s account, Iggy is an adult Scoodle, a Scottish Terrier–Poodle cross, who can also be a little stubborn. His family knew him as a rescue dog. Another owner describes year-old Scout, whose mother was a Scottie and father a Poodle, as an enthusiastic ball chaser who brings it back. These are individual glimpses of the cross rather than a fixed temperament.
VBO:0201193.shortDescription: A Scottish Terrier–Poodle cross; owners describe Iggy’s playfulness and Scout’s enthusiastic ball retrieving.
